 condition.

Clean lenses on combustion chambers and the IRX2 
 scanning head lens.
Check sockets and plugs of IRX2 scanning head.

Check cables and ensure that the screen shield is 
 connected..

Switch power ON and check that early warning 
 indication VS is ON. If VS is not ON, replace power supply.

Apply light (ultra violet) 
 in front of IRX2 lens and check that VS is OFF and RM & RF are ON. If 
 RM or RF is not ON, replace the scanning head.

If both are ON, and VS is off during light 
 check; System is OK.

Close the work 
 order

text:
Equipment:
Flame Monitoring System
 IRIS 3000
 BFI Automation
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedures P1, 
which must be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
COMPONENTS
Flame 
monitoring system function is to monitor the flame in combustion chambers of gas 
turbine version V94.2. There are two monitors on each combustion chamber.
Flame monitoring system consists 
of :
Scanning head type IRX2 (Detector)
Flame monitoring module type IRIS 3001
BFI scanning cable (BFI P/N:KW3).
Heat insulators, P/N: B512
Combustion chamber lenses.
The first 
draft initiated by eng. Salah Aly Yousef, reviewed by eng. Gabr Aly Ramadan, 
tested by eng. Wagdy Kurraat, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Mohamed 
Al Lawindy, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, and approved 
by eng. Mohamed Hamouda Al Sarrag; Head Sector of Damietta CC Power Station.
This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required
Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.
Unit to be in stand still or turning gear 
 condition.
Tools and Equipments
Testing millimeter.
Contact cleaner.
Screw drivers .
Light source
Work
to be Carried Out
Clean lenses on combustion chambers and the IRX2 
 scanning head lens.
Check sockets and plugs of IRX2 scanning head.
Check cables and ensure that the screen shield is 
 connected..
Switch power ON and check that early warning 
 indication VS is ON. If VS is not ON, replace power supply.
Apply light (ultra violet) 
 in front of IRX2 lens and check that VS is OFF and RM & RF are ON. If 
 RM or RF is not ON, replace the scanning head.
If both are ON, and VS is off during light 
 check; System is OK.
Close the work 
 order
